== Update - August 27, 2026 ==

* [[The Purveyor]] (Bonus Merchant) can no longer be summoned while enemies are nearby
* [[Shatterstone]] now ends when the hexed target dies
* Fixed a server disconnect related to [[pet]] AI
* Fixed a client crash on mobile caused by having many different types of salvage kits
